name: Vermilion Torrent
description: Pour a vermilion torrent of blood-qi from the whole body that crashes over a wide arc of ground.

name: Bloodpierce Arc
description: Draw an arc of blood-qi through the air and pierce the target along its curve.

name: Ancestral Pulse
description: Hear the pulse of one's own line in the blood and borrow its steadiness for the user and a near ally.

name: Redwash Mend
description: Wash a deep wound in a long red flow of vital qi until the flesh closes on an ally or the self.

name: Sovereign Vein
description: Take command of a vein in the target and bend the whole flow of its blood to the user's will.

name: Lifestream Absorb
description: Take in the blood-qi of an attack through the skin and turn its force into the user's own vigor.

name: Crimson Phase
description: Turn the body into a veil of blood-mist for an instant and pass through a guard or a thin barrier.

name: Marrow Verdict
description: Pronounce a verdict through the pulse that wounds the target to the marrow past all guard.

name: Lineage Surge
description: The school's surge in which the user calls the strength of the whole line into one pulse and strikes.

name: Heartwell Oath
description: The school's oath that links a chosen ally's heart to the user's well of blood-qi.

name: Kindred Cascade
description: The school's cascade that spreads the user's mending among all kin of blood or oath in reach.

name: Crimson Deluge
description: Flood the ground with blood-qi to the destructive ceiling of its tier and drown all who stand in it.

name: Primordial Beat
description: Return a body's blood to the pulse of its first heartbeat so wounds of the last hour are undone; a consequence event.
